faq.a: Jared Gibbons' agent bio page — a single profile headed "Jared Gibbons – Top South Surrey Realtor & Trusted Real Estate Expert," containing a biography narrative, a six-item list of rankings the page states, and the standard site footer. It has no listings, no area sections and no market data.

faq.q: Which areas and property types does the page say Jared covers?
faq.a: Areas named on the page: South Surrey, Langley, White Rock, Surrey, Brookswood, Cloverdale, Ladner, Tsawwassen and communities across the Fraser Valley. Property types named: condos, townhomes, detached homes, acreages, farms, land and mobile homes, across residential, rural and investment properties — all as the page states them.

faq.q: How do I contact Jared from this page?
faq.a: Through the site footer carried on the page: a "Contact Me" link, office and cell phone both shown as 604-928-1361, the email address shown in the footer block, and the office address #201, 15272 Croydon Drive, Surrey, BC, V3Z 0Z5. The page body has no contact form of its own.

faq.q: What protections do I have when I hire a real estate professional in BC?
faq.a: BCFSA states a licensed professional must give consumers information about commissions and fees, inform them of the duties owed to clients and non-clients, inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party, disclose at the outset whether they can represent you and how to complain to BCFSA, and work for only the buyer or the seller in a transaction.
